reason: Premia Blue / Premia V3 development is explicitly halted; explicitly unmaintained deployments cannot be admitted, including vaults or exit-only calls.

evidence.title: Premia Is Now Kyan | Rebrand FAQs
evidence.observedText: At this point in time, there are no more OLM emissions, and development on Premia Blue (Premia V3) has been halted. While Premia Blue was a milestone for decentralized options trading, our focus is now fully on Kyan.
evidence.vaultObservation: Official FAQ describes a planned new passive yield strategy within Kyan, not continued maintenance of Premia Blue vaults.

evidence.observedText: Premia Labs: Tools for All Traders; current products linked are Kyan and Archetype. Kyan Beta is Live.
evidence.observation: Current collective and successor products are maintained; this does not override explicit Premia V3 maintenance cessation.
Legacy documentation still lists Ethereum, Arbitrum, Fantom and Optimism deployments. Existence of deployment documentation does not establish current maintenance.

limits: This rejection concerns explicitly halted Premia Blue / Premia V3 pools and vaults; it does not assert that Premia Labs has disbanded or that Kyan and Archetype have shut down.
No successor has been silently substituted or counted as a separate eligible protocol.
No capabilities or deployment ABI inventories are activated by this rejection record.
